svg.desc: You send a prompt to the agent. The agent decides whether saved work could change its next decision. If yes, it calls brain_recall: Brain checks project access, loads task state, searches active lessons, and optionally uses Jev to filter matched lessons. If no, the agent uses context already available. The agent checks live facts, works, verifies the result, and answers you. When useful state changes, it explicitly saves a checkpoint for later recall or an experience with result evidence. Full prompts and chats are not automatically collected.

Follow the arrows. The agent chooses when to call each Brain tool.
Brain does not intercept each prompt.
The agent follows its tool instructions.
Keep or unsure → return the lesson
Off or failed? Return normal recall.
Verify the result, then answer you.
During work, at a hand-off, or after a checked outcome. Each save is a tool call.
Available when this task is recalled.
No save call → no new Brain record. Prompts and full chats are not collected automatically.
